topicName: Liên từ và mệnh đề trạng ngữ

rules.rule: Liên từ chỉ sự nhượng bộ, tương phản:
rules.formula: Although / Even though / Though + S + V, S + V // In spite of / Despite + N / V-ing, S + V
rules.examples: Although it rained heavily, we went to school on time. / Despite the heavy rain, we went to school.

rules.rule: Lưu ý cấm kỵ: Tuyệt đối KHÔNG dùng cả 'Although' và 'But' trong cùng một câu!
rules.formula: ĐÚNG: Although it rained, we went out. HOẶC It rained, but we went out. (SAI: Although it rained, but we went out.)
rules.examples: Although he was tired, he finished his work.

rules.rule: Liên từ chỉ lý do, nguyên nhân:
rules.formula: Because / Since / As + S + V, S + V // Because of / Due to + N / V-ing, S + V
rules.examples: Because she was ill, she stayed home. / Because of her illness, she stayed home.

rules.rule: Cấu trúc So... that và Such... that (quá... đến nỗi mà):
rules.formula: S + be/V + SO + adj/adv + THAT + S + V // S + V + SUCH + (a/an) + adj + N + THAT + S + V
rules.examples: The tea is so hot that I cannot drink it. / It was such hot tea that I could not drink it.

rules.formula: so that / in order that + S + can/could/will/would + V-inf // in order to / so as to / to + V-inf
rules.examples: He studies hard so that he can pass the exam. / He studies hard in order to pass the exam.
